items.markdown:
![When You Should Use a Breadcrumb Navigation](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10081734-2633-0066-0000-474d58eaf176:4)
Breadcrumbs UI is `a secondary navigation aid that shows users their current location within a website or application's hierarchical structure`.[[1]](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/breadcrumbs/)[[2]](https://www.setproduct.com/blog/breadcrumbs-ui-design)

### Key Anatomy & Rules

- **Hierarchy over History:** Show the site structure (e.g., Home > Category > Page), not the user's sequential browsing history.[[1]](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/breadcrumbs/)
- **Current Page State:** The final item represents the current page, should not be a link, and is often visually distinct.[[1]](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/breadcrumbs/)
- **Separators:** Commonly use chevrons (`›` ) or slashes (`/` ) between links.[[1]](https://www.setproduct.com/blog/breadcrumbs-ui-design)
- **Placement:** Position left-aligned near the top of the page, above the main header or title.[[1]](https://www.lightningdesignsystem.com/2e1ef8501/p/13cc12-breadcrumbs)

### When to Use

- **Deep Hierarchies:** Sites with three or more levels of depth.[[1]](https://www.lightningdesignsystem.com/2e1ef8501/p/13cc12-breadcrumbs)
- **Direct Landing:** Helping users who arrive at interior pages via external search engine links find their bearings.[[1]](https://designsystem.digital.gov/components/breadcrumb/)
- **Complementary Role:** Used alongside, not as a replacement for, primary global navigation.[[1]](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/breadcrumbs/)

Frameworks like [Material UI React Breadcrumbs](https://mui.com/material-ui/react-breadcrumbs/) provide accessible, out-of-the-box components following WAI-ARIA standards. For deep design guidelines, review the [Nielsen Norman Group Breadcrumbs Guide](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/breadcrumbs/).[[1]](https://mui.com/material-ui/react-breadcrumbs/)[[2]](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/breadcrumbs/)If you'd like, let me know:
